newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan seeks car talks with Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Japan seeks car talks with Indonesia.

text.p: Japanese Trade Minister Shunpei Tsukahara said on Tuesday that he wants to discuss Indonesia's car policy when he visits the country in mid-September.
"I would like discuss the issue. I would like to deal with the issue calmly and take necessary procedures," Tsukahara told a news conference.

Japan has threatened to take Indonesia to the World Trade Organisation over its car policy which allows only PT Timor Putra Nasional to import vehicles free of the tariffs and luxury taxes imposed on other car makers. The firm imports vehicles from South Korea.
Tsukahara will visit Jakarta from September 12 to 14 to attend an annual meeting of Association of Southeast Asian Nations economic ministers to discuss various areas of economic cooperation.
ASEAN groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
